method.reason: Request delegates method/basis for a gas-phase, closed-shell (RKS, singlet) conformational scan of butane explicitly for relative electronic energies. A self-contained *-3c composite (r2SCAN meta-GGA plus def2-mTZVPP-quality basis and D4 dispersion) is efficient enough for 7 constrained optimizations within the frozen budgets (12 ORCA starts, 192 MB/core, 4 cores) while treating the dispersion that dominates butane conformer energetics. Constrained optimizations at fixed dihedral are not vibrational or transition-state validation; convergence and the fixed-dihedral energies remain the reported evidence, so the composite's approximations are recorded as a limitation rather than a validated result.

basis.reason: r2SCAN-3c is a self-contained composite whose def2-mTZVPP-quality orbital basis and dispersion correction are implied by the method keyword; no competing orbital-basis keyword is added, avoiding a conflicting basis selector. This is a selection, not scientific validation: absolute/relative energies remain unverified until actual ORCA outputs are inspected.

proposal.reason: Method and basis were explicitly delegated (automatic_selection=['method','basis']) and must be fixed before any ORCA execution; choosing a cheap, dispersion-aware composite for the seven constrained butane optimizations, and recording the basis as the method-intrinsic 'built-in' so no conflicting selector is written. No documentation query is required for this first step; rationale is model reasoning.
